fields.title: Magnetic Eyeglasses Holder (5437940)
fields.description: I need glasses (or a microscope) to read some food labels. I was looking for a good storage place in the kitchen for my glasses and I stumbled upon a few glasses holder designs. I decided to make my own slightly different to stick on a refrigerator or other metal surface in the kitchen. The 8mm dia. X 2mm thick magnet (10 for $2.99 at Harbor Freight, 67488) is press fit into the hole. I was going to glue it but after I put it in the hole to check the fit, it was so hard to remove, I left it. I printed this in resin using default Chitubox settings for my Elegoo Mars printer in Elegoo Translucent Standard resin except that the support density is 70% and the support angle is 60°. The holders are angled at 45° on the buildplate. (Except for the magnet fit, the dimensions are not critical and there is very little load on it.) fields.title: Eyeglasses Nose Pads (2873017)
fields.description: Made these for a pair of Zenni Sunglasses when my wife broke one of the pads. They use a tiny screw to hold them or you can use a tiny piece of wirewrap wire as a temporary fix. They worked well in an emergency. I used a raft without any supports since the up curve layers are tolerable for my printer (AnyCubic i3 Mega) and it printed well on the Ultrabase glass surface in PLA 200/50 degrees. I carefully pried them off the raft and gently sanded the rounded top, cleaned out the screw holes with a fine pair of tweezers and they installed very nice. The wife is happy! Maybe now she'll buy me another roll of clear filament... LOL Enjoy
